title: 5 分钟后关闭显示器
Turn off display after 5 minutes
description: 插电空闲超时，单位为秒；只修改活动方案，保留电池设置。
AC idle timeout in seconds, in the active scheme only. Battery values are preserved.

title: 15 分钟后关闭显示器
Turn off display after 15 minutes
description: 插电空闲超时，单位为秒；只修改活动方案，保留电池设置。
AC idle timeout in seconds, in the active scheme only. Battery values are preserved.

title: 30 分钟后关闭显示器
Turn off display after 30 minutes
description: 插电空闲超时，单位为秒；只修改活动方案，保留电池设置。
AC idle timeout in seconds, in the active scheme only. Battery values are preserved.

title: 不因空闲超时关闭显示器
Disable display idle timeout
description: 禁用插电时的显示器空闲关闭计时器；锁屏、合盖和系统睡眠仍可能关闭显示器。
Disables the AC display idle timer. Locking, lid closure and system sleep may still turn the display off.

title: 15 分钟后睡眠
Sleep after 15 minutes
description: 插电空闲睡眠超时，单位为秒；实际效果取决于硬件和系统策略。
AC sleep idle timeout in seconds. Actual behavior depends on hardware and system policy.

title: 30 分钟后睡眠
Sleep after 30 minutes
description: 插电空闲睡眠超时，单位为秒；实际效果取决于硬件和系统策略。
AC sleep idle timeout in seconds. Actual behavior depends on hardware and system policy.

title: 60 分钟后睡眠
Sleep after 60 minutes
description: 插电空闲睡眠超时，单位为秒；实际效果取决于硬件和系统策略。
AC sleep idle timeout in seconds. Actual behavior depends on hardware and system policy.

title: 不因空闲超时睡眠
Disable sleep idle timeout
description: 禁用插电空闲睡眠计时器；手动操作、合盖、临界电量或其他系统策略仍可能触发睡眠或休眠。
Disables the AC sleep idle timer. Manual actions, lid closure, critical battery and other policies can still trigger sleep or hibernation.

title: 10 分钟后关闭空闲磁盘
Turn off idle disk after 10 minutes
description: 插电磁盘空闲超时，单位为秒，0禁用该计时器。Modern Standby 客户端不使用此策略。
AC disk idle timeout in seconds; 0 disables this timer. Modern Standby clients do not use this policy.

title: 20 分钟后关闭空闲磁盘
Turn off idle disk after 20 minutes
description: 插电磁盘空闲超时，单位为秒，0禁用该计时器。Modern Standby 客户端不使用此策略。
AC disk idle timeout in seconds; 0 disables this timer. Modern Standby clients do not use this policy.

title: 从不关闭空闲磁盘
Never turn off idle disk
description: 插电磁盘空闲超时，单位为秒，0禁用该计时器。Modern Standby 客户端不使用此策略。
AC disk idle timeout in seconds; 0 disables this timer. Modern Standby clients do not use this policy.

title: 开启 USB 选择性挂起
Enable USB selective suspend
description: 插电枚举值1，启用USB选择性挂起。Microsoft建议保持启用以减少耗电。
AC enum 1 enables USB selective suspend. Microsoft recommends keeping it enabled to reduce power use.

title: 关闭 USB 选择性挂起
Disable USB selective suspend
description: 插电枚举值0，禁用USB选择性挂起，可能增加耗电。仅在确认设备兼容性需求时选择。
AC enum 0 disables USB selective suspend and may increase power use. Select only for a confirmed device compatibility need.

title: 关闭 PCIe 链路省电
Disable PCIe link power saving
description: 插电枚举：0关闭、1适度、2最大链路节能；实际效果取决于设备和系统支持。
AC enum: 0 off, 1 moderate, 2 maximum link power saving. Actual behavior depends on device and system support.

title: PCIe 链路适度省电
Moderate PCIe link power saving
description: 插电枚举：0关闭、1适度、2最大链路节能；实际效果取决于设备和系统支持。
AC enum: 0 off, 1 moderate, 2 maximum link power saving. Actual behavior depends on device and system support.

title: PCIe 链路最大省电
Maximum PCIe link power saving
description: 插电枚举：0关闭、1适度、2最大链路节能；实际效果取决于设备和系统支持。
AC enum: 0 off, 1 moderate, 2 maximum link power saving. Actual behavior depends on device and system support.
